main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: 1. Imperatoris electionemCùm Germania à Francorum regno secessionem fecisset, Imperatores sibi liberis suffragiis ex suâ ratione præfecerunt: plerunq; autem ex potentissimis familiis Saxonum, Francorum, Svevorum, Bavarorum & tandem Austriacorum.
2. Marchionatuum constitutionēSub Heinrico Aucupe Mar-chionatus constituti fuere.
main_text.head: Explicatio:
main_text.p: Causa fuit Hungarorum, Polono-rum[?], Slavorum, Vandalorum, Danorum ac Normannorum in Germaniam frequentes irruptiones. Heinricus igitur Auceps A. C. 927. contra Henetos[?] constituit Marchionatum Brandeburgensem, nec non contra Danos Slesvicensem; A. C. 928. contra Hungaros Austriacum; A. C. 930 contra Bohemos, Polonos, Silesios, Misnicum.

page.notes: Printed text in the left margin read as notes 1 and 2; their wrapped words were joined. "Polono-rum" at the line end is partly obscured, so the second part is doubtful. "Henetos" is doubtful. The word "Misnicum" breaks at the line end; no hyphen is clearly printed. Faint show-through from the facing page is ignored. Catchword "Ca" at bottom right is partly cut off.
